reference.pathophysiology: Mottled oliguric confusion with lactate sorts shock into warm distributive, cold cardiogenic, obstructive distended and hypovolaemic dry while bedside echo with IVC and ScvO2 steer balanced fluids, noradrenaline-first pressors, dobutamine for low output and ratio blood for bleeders.
additionalDifferentials: Cardiogenic versus obstructive versus distributive versus hypovolaemic by lungs necks warmth and bleed
Sepsis versus bleed versus MI versus anaphylaxis by cultures haemoglobin troponin and exposure
Adrenal versus thyroid versus neurogenic by cortisol heat and tone
